title: Ordered coefficient comparison data and normalization interfaces
statement: Fix the adic coefficient datum of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and the strict tower operations of [def-weil-pbc-strict-tower-operations], together with the constant reduction model of [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison]. Record the existing exact scalar restriction, ordinary and derived quotient balancing comparisons and their specified complex counit normalizations, inverse-limit comparison and its unit normalization, the complete full subcategories, completed pullback scalar comparison, source and target reconstruction maps, and raw and constant normalized natural transformations. All maps retain their original universal unit, counit, tensor-section and strict-tower definitions. This is the unchanged interface used by the separated coefficient equations.
